calls.title: GrowthBook <> Brightscout | Content Session
calls.summary: The team discussed the timeline for delivering design-ready pages, targeting February 13th to initiate development. Daniela Ferrer presented a revised calendar that eliminates a buffer period, necessitating quicker feedback from the GrowthBook team. The group agreed on standardizing page structures while allowing for unique content needs, with a focus on SEO consistency. They emphasized the importance of aligning messaging from the homepage to product pages to enhance user experience. Daily stand-up meetings were approved to ensure alignment and address any blockers, while roles and responsibilities were clarified to improve process efficiency. The team also agreed on focusing on the first 13-14 pages for the next review cycle, with specific deliverables due shortly to maintain momentum.
calls.keywords: Delivery Timeline, Content Structure, Page Templates, Development Workload, SEO Alignment, CMS Migration
